create_MinitaurMotorModel: create a MinitaurMotorModel instance with a specified number of motors and custom voltage parameters
get_motor_torques: get motor torques by converting position control commands to actual and observed torque values
convert_to_torque_from_pwm: convert a PWM signal and motor velocity into observed and actual torque using the current-torque profile
set_voltage: set the motor voltage on an existing MinitaurMotorModel instance to a new value
set_viscous_damping: set the viscous damping coefficient on a MinitaurMotorModel instance for friction modeling
